question: In October 2023, Raghubar Das has been appointed the Governor of which of the following states of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raghubar Das** has been appointed the **Governor** of **Odisha** in **October 2023**.
 
• Raghubar Das is a senior politician affiliated with the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
• He has previously served as the **Chief Minister of Jharkhand** from 2014 to 2019.
 
• As a Governor, he will act as the **constitutional head of Odisha** and serve as a liaison between the state and the central government.
 
• The role of a Governor in India includes responsibilities such as **assenting to bills** passed by the state legislature, **summoning and proroguing sessions** of the state legislative assembly, and **maintaining law and order** in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **West Bengal**__

 __
 
• West Bengal is a state located in the eastern region of India, sharing borders with Bangladesh, Bhutan, and Nepal.
 
• The capital of West Bengal is **Kolkata**, which is known as the cultural capital of India.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra**__
 __
 
• Maharashtra is a state in the western peninsular region of India, known for its fast-paced economy and the city of **Mumbai**, which is the financial capital of India.
 
• The state has a rich cultural heritage and is also home to the **Bollywood film industry**.
 
 
 
• **Chhattisgarh**__
 
 
• Chhattisgarh is a state located in central India, known for its rich mineral resources and diverse tribal culture.
 
• The state capital is **Raipur**, which is an important commercial hub in the region.
